name: surreal-tear-frame
authority: The workspace line simultaneity-order (notes/surreal-order-and-the-tear.md) and the nine-line criterion it quotes from helgoland/src/tear_witness.py; this contract authorizes one bounded re-execution of that enumeration and nothing else.
question: On finite surreal cut presentations, does the order descend through the task/state map, and where does a tear live?
level: Finite exact enumeration over surreal cut presentations built from {L|R} with rational arithmetic; standard library only; no matrix language, no differential forms
domain: Surreal forms up to a bounded birthday, their L/R address words, the presentation day of a value, the nine-line descent criterion q(h)=q(h') => c(h)=c(h'), and the fibre size of each state

objects.criterion: a clock descends iff no witness pair (h,h') has q(h)=q(h') and c(h)!=c(h')
objects.A: order descent over the enumerated pairs

quantifiers: every pair of forms up to the frozen birthday
every L/R address word of each day class
every state fibre, with its size and capacity
acceptance: the re-execution reproduces the retained evidence exactly, field for field
every self-check recorded by the run is true, and the run reports them rather than asserting them
the criterion is exercised in both directions on planted cases: a clock that descends returns None and a clock that does not returns a witness pair
the checker imports nothing outside the standard library
the count of enumerated pairs is the recorded one and is recomputed, not read
protected: Research 0021 (surreal cut presentations, objectification, PSP-star no-go) separates finite surreal cut presentations from the surreal numbers they objectify. This experiment stays on the PRESENTATION side: it does not claim objectification, a PSP* factorization, or that the objectified number can serve as a carrier. It must respect that boundary.
No matrix language is used: no H, J, G, O, no Laplacian and no spectrum appear in the checker. That is the point of the experiment, not a stylistic choice.
No claim is made about which clock or which task is right; those are declarations, and changing them can create or remove a tear.
The evidence is a finite enumeration on one machine; nothing transfers to another birthday bound without re-running it.
residual: The experiment gives one criterion, applied to finite surreal cut presentations, with a retained witness for the tear. What it does not do is decide which clock is right, or connect the presentation side to the objectified side that Research 0021 fences off.
